meta.label: Rockhampton Thu — Soft 5, rail +3m, B1-5 strength 1

games.rundown: Newcastle are laying -12.5 at home against a Titans side deep in the bottom four — the biggest line and the highest-rated pick of the round.
games.whyshort: The round's top-rated pick — Knights at home, laying a big line.

games.rundown: Cronulla at home laying -10.5 against a Raiders side that's dropped its last two — a strong top-four side fancied to cover comfortably.
games.whyshort: Top-four Sharks heavily fancied at home.

games.rundown: The Warriors travel with the handicap in their favour at +6.5, against a Broncos side that's lost three on the trot.
games.whyshort: Warriors' form and the handicap both stack up on the road.

games.rundown: Manly have dropped four straight — the Dolphins take the +9.5 and look well placed to cover comfortably away from home.
games.whyshort: Dolphins fancied against a Manly side in freefall.

games.rundown: Parramatta sit 13th and out of form — the Cowboys travel with +5.5 in the bank and the better recent record.
games.whyshort: Cowboys' form edge plus a handicap buffer on the road.

games.rundown: Canterbury are laying -3.5 at home in a genuine six-pointer against a Souths side that's been up and down all season.
games.whyshort: Bulldogs favoured at home in a tight mid-table clash.

games.rundown: Both sides sit level atop the ladder. Penrith lay -2.5 at home against a Roosters outfit riding a five-game winning streak — the round's premier clash.
games.whyshort: Ladder-leading Panthers at home in the round's biggest clash.

games.rundown: Bottom-of-the-table clash between two sides fighting to avoid the spoon. The Dragons snapped a four-game skid with an upset over Cronulla last start, but the Tigers take the lean at +0.5 and the extra rest from the bye.
games.whyshort: The round's tightest game — bottom-table six-pointer, lowest-rated pick.
